# Every stage dumps in both structural formats, with and without --omit, and
# a dump in-process leaves the IR and ASTs every check shares as it found
# them: the checked stage is dumped several times here.
#
# A declaration is written in full once, where the walk first meets it in a
# position that owns it, and named by a (ref) anywhere else; the library is
# only ever named. A map keyed by declarations is written in one order, its
# keys told apart by the declaration's (id).

sngl dump --stage parsed --format spew main.sngl
stdout 'main.sngl:5:1'
sngl dump --stage parsed --format spew --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout '"Name": \(string\) \(len=4\) "main"'
! stdout 'main.sngl:5:1'
sngl dump --stage parsed --format json --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout '"Name": "main"'

sngl dump --stage checked --format spew main.sngl
stdout '"Name": \(string\) \(len=4\) "main"'
stdout '"\(ref\)": \(string\) \(len=12\) "ir.Component"'
! stdout '(Pos": \(string\) \(len=\d+\) "|Pos: \(ast\.Pos\) )(builtin|ui)/'
sngl dump --stage checked --format spew --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout '"Name": \(string\) \(len=4\) "main"'
sngl dump --stage checked --format json main.sngl
stdout '"Name": "main"'
stdout -count=1 '"\(ref\)": "ir.Component",\s+"Name": "button",\s+"Pkg": "sngl:ui"'
! stdout '"File": "(ui|builtin)/'
sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout '"Name": "main"'

sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST methods.sngl
# Thirteen functions, methods and lambdas included, each with one body.
stdout -count=13 '"Block"'
cp stdout first.json
sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST methods.sngl
cmp stdout first.json
sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST methods.sngl
cmp stdout first.json

# A declaration a directory package makes is named with the directory, a
# context included, whose package the IR does not record.
cd proj
sngl dump --stage checked --format json app.sngl
stdout -count=1 '"\(ref\)": "ir.Context",\s+"Name": "depth",\s+"Pkg": "dir:shapes"'
stdout '"\(ref\)": "ir.Component",\s+"Name": "badge",\s+"Pkg": "dir:shapes"'
stdout '"At": "s.sngl:3:20"'
sngl dump --stage checked --format json --omit AST,Pos app.sngl
! stdout '"At"'
cd ..

sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format spew --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout 'ast.Document'
sngl dump --stage lowered --platform html --lang none --format json --omit AST,Pos main.sngl
stdout '"Stmts"'

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

const greeting = "hi"

component main node {
    var n = 0
    button(text="{greeting} {n}", @click { n += 1 })
}

window {
    main
}
-- methods.sngl --

import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

func run(f func()) {
    f()
}

func applied(f func() int) => f()

component inner(@fired) node {
    var ran = 0

    func go() {
        run(func() {
            ran += 1
            fired()
        })
    }

    text(value="{ran}")
}

component main node {
    var (
        viaMethod = 0
        emitted = 0
    )

    inner #child(@fired {
        emitted += 1
    })
    func bump() {
        run(func() {
            viaMethod += 1
        })
    }

    text(value="{viaMethod}:{emitted}")
}

func testACallbackRuns(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(applied(func() => 7) == 7)
}

func testACallbackWritesALocal(t Test, c main) {
    var local = 0

    run(func() {
        local += 1
    })
    t.assert(local == 1)
}

func testACallbackWritesComponentState(t Test, c main) {
    c.bump()
    t.assert(c.viaMethod == 1)
}

func testACallbackEmits(t Test, c main) {
    c.child.go()
    t.assert(c.child.ran == 1)
    t.assert(c.emitted == 1)
}

window {
    main
}
-- proj/app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "./shapes"

component badge node {
    text(value="mine")
}

window {
    badge
    shapes.badge
}
-- proj/shapes/s.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

context[int] #depth(3)

component badge ui.node {
    ui.text(value="{depth}")
}
